_comment: G2 real-world editing tasks (PHOTO-GEN benchmark, model-independent). Pre-registered 2026-10-07 BEFORE any G2 edit was run and before any full-size source was decoded (instructions, must-change / must-not-change lists, seeds and regions were written from 900-px previews). One task per source photograph (source-manifest.json). 'regions': normalized [x0, y0, x1, y1] on the oriented source; 'change' = where the requested edit is expected (local edits; descriptive metrics only), 'preserve' = a subject that must stay (metric: inside-MAE); global/background edits have no change region. 'text': 'change' = the requested change is text, 'preserve' = legible text that must stay unchanged, null = no text criterion. Seeds are fresh (never used by any earlier Qwen run: every earlier Qwen edit used seed 42) and fixed here.

edit_parameters.note: upstream defaults (guidance 1.0, prefix KV cache, linear flow-match schedule, --low-ram); nothing is tuned during the gate

tasks.instruction: Change her white top to a dark green top.
tasks.must_change: the white top she is wearing becomes dark green
must_not_change: her face and identity (features, expression, skin tone)

tasks.instruction: Remove the dark grey van parked in front of the building.
tasks.must_change: the van is gone; the pavement, street and building base behind it are plausibly filled in
must_not_change: the building facade, windows and balcony
the red no-entry sign and its pole
the blue street-name sign on the wall

tasks.instruction: Make the shoes out of brown suede instead of blue canvas.
tasks.must_change: the uppers of both shoes become brown suede (visible suede texture, brown colour)
must_not_change: the shape and placement of both shoes
the plain white background and the soft shadows

tasks.instruction: Replace the small bowl of guacamole with a small bowl of black olives.
tasks.must_change: the small cup of green guacamole becomes a small cup of black olives in about the same place
must_not_change: the quesadilla wedges and their toppings

tasks.instruction: Add a grey cat sleeping on the sofa.
tasks.must_change: a grey cat lies asleep on the sofa
must_not_change: the sofa's shape and light-blue colour
the framed picture on the wall
the wooden floor and the walls

tasks.instruction: Turn this into a winter scene with snow covering the mountains and the rocky slopes.
tasks.must_change: snow covers the mountains and slopes; the scene reads as winter
must_not_change: the layout: mountain shapes and ridgelines, the lake's position and shape, the rocky trail
the two hikers in the foreground and their poses

tasks.instruction: Change the color of the car from turquoise to bright red.
tasks.must_change: the car's body paint is bright red
must_not_change: the chrome grille, bumpers and trim
the road, kerb and the trees

tasks.instruction: Change the text on the hanging sign from "MacBike" to "CityBike".
tasks.must_change: the hanging sign reads exactly "CityBike" (correct letters, no leftover or ghosted letters)
must_not_change: the sign board's shape, colours and lettering style
the street, the people and bicycles in the distance

tasks.edit_type: localized object replacement in a busy scene
tasks.instruction: Replace the pink dragon fruits with green apples. Do not change anything else.
tasks.must_change: the pile of pink dragon fruits becomes a pile of green apples
must_not_change: the mangoes, oranges, avocados, grapes and the other fruit piles
the ground and the scene layout

tasks.edit_type: colour change on fine texture (knitted wool)
tasks.instruction: Change the turquoise yarn of the knitted sweater to red yarn.
tasks.must_change: the turquoise knitted parts become red
must_not_change: the knit stitch texture and pattern

tasks.instruction: Change the red wine in the glass to white wine.
tasks.must_change: the wine in the glass is a pale white wine, still transparent
must_not_change: the glass's shape, rim and reflections
the red glass stem and the foot

regions.what: wine in the bowl of the glass

tasks.edit_type: object (person) removal at night in a busy, wet, neon-lit street
tasks.instruction: Remove the man in dark clothes walking towards the camera in the middle of the street.
tasks.must_change: that man is gone; the wet pavement and the people behind him are plausibly filled in
must_not_change: the "MATHEW STREET - BIRTHPLACE of THE BEATLES" banner and its lettering
the "Quarry Quarter" and other shop signs
the wet reflections and the night lighting

regions.what: the man walking towards the camera

tasks.instruction: Replace the clear blue sky with a dramatic sunset sky with orange and pink clouds.
tasks.must_change: the sky is a sunset sky with orange and pink clouds
must_not_change: the church: tower, spire, clock, windows and roof

regions.what: background (sky) edit; warmer light on the building is acceptable

tasks.instruction: Turn this photo into a watercolor painting.
tasks.must_change: the whole image is rendered as a watercolour painting
must_not_change: the dog's pose and black-and-white markings
the red collar and the leash

tasks.instruction: Paint the brick wall around the shop white. Keep the shop sign and all lettering exactly as they are.
tasks.must_change: the brick facade around the shop becomes white-painted brick
must_not_change: the "Beguiling" sign and all its lettering and artwork
the window displays, posters and the lettering on the glass

regions.what: facade edit; preserve = sign + shop windows + door

tasks.instruction: Add a croissant on the table next to the coffee cup.
tasks.must_change: a croissant lies on the wooden table next to the cup
must_not_change: the yellow cup, its handle and the coffee with foam

regions.what: addition with free placement; preserve = the cup
